overview: Orchard Watch is a three-lane garden defense game with a small seed economy. Start with enough seeds for two guards, place them on fixed pads and earn more by defeating advancing enemies. The documented nine-wave presentation is implemented as nine scheduled attackers rotating between the lanes.
rules: A guard costs two seeds and occupies one lane’s fixed pad; buying an occupied pad spends nothing.
Guards attack automatically when an enemy is in range; defeated enemies award two seeds.
An attacker reaching the orchard costs one of three hearts. Losing all hearts loses the run.
Survive until all nine scheduled attackers are gone to win.
controls: Click/Enter starts; click a guard pad to build.
K saves; L resumes; R restarts; M toggles sound.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
